name: Einstein's Spacetime
summary: Our unique, interactive simulation immerses you in the core principles of Einstein’s theory of general relativity. Embark on an exhilarating journey where you wield the power to manipulate mass, exploring the curvature of not just three spatial dimensions, but also time itself, shaping the very fabric of reality with your every move!
